## Overview

For the fifth session of the 3 B’s series, we cover some of the basics of population structure analyses in R. This will not be a lecture on the theory of population genetics, but rather how you can use R to create plots and make them ready for your publication.

## Prerequisites

 If you would like to prepare in advance, please have a look at this vignette.

As always, you are most welcome to drop by and listen without participating.
